pr.title: Pass execution context to Bicep parameter value providers
pr.author: eerhardt

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, dynamic-debug-configuration)
failed_jobs.reason: The job fails due to a known flaky teardown issue in the VS Code extension E2E dynamic-debug-configuration test suite: an EBUSY 'resource busy or locked' error on rmdir of a Windows temp workspace directory. This is unrelated to the PR's changes, which only touch Bicep parameter value provider code (src/Aspire.Hosting.Azure/Provisioning/*, tests/Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests/*). The failure matches a previously tracked recurring flaky-test cause with 4 prior occurrences.
